title: Get a member's savings balance
description: Looks a member up by member number and returns the current balance of their Regular Savings share.
goal: Sign on to the teller workstation, look up member {{inputs.member_id}}, and read the current balance of their Regular Savings account.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member number to look up.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's Regular Savings share, as a decimal string in USD.
